# CANDIDATE: shotgun_scalper_stage3_top_keeper

**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** exit_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Tightening the stop loss to 35% premium (from typical 50%) reduces losses on J loser days while maintaining winner day profitability through OTM-2 strike selection and volume-filtered entries. The chandelier profit lock arms at 50% favor (vs typical 5%) to let winners run longer, capturing more of the ribbon-ride edge on bullish-structured days like 5/04.

## Mechanism

**Entry:**  
- Strike: OTM-2 put (strike_offset=2)  
- Volume filter: vol_ratio_threshold >= 1.0 (current bar volume >= 20-bar average volume)  
**Exit:**  
- Take profit: tp_premium_pct=1.5 (150% of premium)  
- Stop loss: stop_premium_pct=-0.35 (35% of premium)  
- Time stop: time_stop_min=15 minutes  
- Chandelier profit lock: arms at chandelier_arm_pct=0.5 (50% favor), trails 15% off high-water mark (per playbook v15 logic)
